decisions.label: Challenge pack as statues
decisions.note: The challenge circle's pack stand as grey stone statues by their columns till a witch steps onto its floor, then wake over a few bars (Ed, 2026-11-04: "the creatures around it only start to aggro you when you go into the challenge circle"). Off: wild from the start, watching her come down anywhere in its area. A new night: it reloads.

decisions.label: Challenge wake-up (bars)
decisions.note: How many bars the statues glow red before they wake, from the next bar line after she steps in (Ed, 2026-11-04: "after 8 seconds, they all awaken": 4 bars at 120 bpm).

decisions.label: Challenge statues: adult in from column (m)
decisions.note: How far in from its column a kind's first statue (its adult) stands, toward the circle's middle (Ed, 2026-11-04: "they should be closer to their column than to the centre"; never past 0.45 of the way in). A new night: it reloads.

decisions.label: Challenge statues: gap between posts (m)
decisions.note: How much further in each next statue of a kind stands (its youth after its adult), still nearer its column than the middle (Ed, 2026-11-04: "Further apart, same line": 12.5, the youth 16 m in on the 36 m circle, the most that keeps it nearer its column). A new night: it reloads.

decisions.label: Challenge statues: youth in front
decisions.note: On the columns south of the circle's middle, the youth stands nearer the column than its adult, so it's in front of the adult as the camera sees it, never hidden behind it (Ed, 2026-11-04: "Further apart, same line"; the builder's choice, for Ed to judge). Off: the adult nearest the column on every column. A new night: it reloads.

decisions.label: Challenge statues: walk back pace
decisions.note: How fast the un-won walk back to their posts once every witch is knocked down or up in the treetops outside the challenge area, times their own pace, before turning to stone again.

decisions.label: Challenge: won ones keep out of the circle (m)
decisions.note: While the fight's on, how far off the circle's edge the won (invited) challenge animals keep as they roam its area (Ed, 2026-11-04: "While the fight is going on, won creatures should avoid the circle").

decisions.label: Won ones keep out of her fights' way
decisions.note: A creature she's won over whose sigil waits in its stone's stack roams its area clear of her fights (Ed, 2026-11-04: "they should roam the whole area, and avoid creatures that are fighting"; "Newly won creatures can't be grabbed until the spell is cast, so they don't need to be near"). Off: they roam as before.

decisions.label: Won ones: keep from fighters (m)
decisions.note: How far her won-over creatures waiting for their stone's spell keep from any creature fighting her or with her, in every area and the challenge circle.

decisions.label: Challenge statues: stone tint
decisions.note: How far the statues are drawn toward the stone grey (Ed, 2026-11-04: "grey statues"): 1 all stone, 0 their own colours.

decisions.label: Challenge statues: red at waking
decisions.note: How red the statues glow by the end of their wake-up (Ed, 2026-11-04: "all the animals glow red").

decisions.label: Challenge spell analyser: bars
decisions.note: How many bars the music spell's analyser has round the challenge circle as she casts (Ed, 2026-11-04: "the audio analyser filling the whole stone circle").

decisions.label: Challenge spell analyser: dots a bar
decisions.note: How many dots each analyser bar has out to the circle's edge at the music's loudest (more: finer and costlier).

decisions.label: Challenge spell analyser: reach
decisions.note: How far out the analyser's bars reach at the loudest, a share of the circle's radius.

decisions.label: Challenge floor sigil: asleep
decisions.note: How much the circle's carved sigil catches the moonlight while its statues sleep: dark but readable, not glowing.

decisions.label: Challenge floor sigil: waking red
decisions.note: How bright the carved sigil glows red by the end of the statues' wake-up (it rises over the bars, brighter on each beat).

decisions.label: Challenge floor sigil: fight
decisions.note: The carved sigil's steady cold glow while the pack is awake.

decisions.label: Challenge floor sigil: won
decisions.note: The carved sigil's warm glow once every column is lit, before the spell's dancefloor covers it.

decisions.label: Challenge floor sigil: fade to dark (s)
decisions.note: How long the carved sigil takes to fade back to dark when the pack goes back to stone.

decisions.label: Challenge floor: moonlight
decisions.note: A little more moonlight on the challenge circle's stone floor, so it reads as a circle before she steps in (keep it subtle).
